run_ObjectDetection: run the ObjectDetection handler on an RGBDepth frame to detect objects with class labels and properties
run_DetectorBase: run the DetectorBase predictor on an image to get instance predictions with masks, boxes, and centers
create_Detection: create a Detection WorldObject from an RGBDepth frame with class label, properties, mask, and bounding box
summarize_Detection_to_struct: summarize a Detection object into a dictionary with id, xyz, bbox, label, properties, and mask points
run_Detection_get_masked_img: run get_masked_img on a Detection to extract the cropped image region using the bounding box mask
